notes: Class balance pass — equal card counts per class, new Epics for Courage/Serenity/Hope, new Purpose Gold, and all v0.8.26 balance changes fully live.
features: CLASS BALANCE — All four classes now have equal card counts per rarity: 5 Bronze, 3 Silver, 4 Gold, 2 Epic, 4 Legendary, 1 Platinum each.
NEW COURAGE EPICS — Relentless Drive (6-cost 6/4, Charge+Storm) and Battle Hardened (5-cost 5/5, gives all allies +1/+1 on play).
NEW SERENITY EPIC — Still Waters (6-cost 4/8, Guard + restore 3 defense on play).
NEW HOPE EPIC — Healing Grace (5-cost 4/6, restore 4 defense and draw a card on play).
NEW PURPOSE GOLD — Structured Plan (4-cost 3/5, draw a card then reduce the highest-cost card in hand by 1).
COPY LIMITS EXPANDED — Legendaries now allow 3 copies per deck (up from 2). Platinums, Signature Platinums, and Signature Golds now allow 2 copies per deck (up from 1). Epics remain at 3.

PHOENIX RISING REDESIGNED — Now a 1-cost 1/1. When destroyed, it gets back up at the start of your next turn at +1/+1 (1/1 → 2/2 → … → 10/10). At 10/10 it falls permanently. Cannot return if banished or transformed.
TURNING POINT — New Purpose Legendary (3-cost, 2/4). On Play: if your leader has less defense than the enemy, draw 2 cards and gain 1 maximum PP.
PURPOSE ETERNAL RECLASSIFIED — Rarity changed from Legendary to Epic, meaning you can now run up to 3 copies. Ability upgraded to Charge-Storm.
VOICE OF REASSURANCE REWORKED — Cost reduced from 9 to 3 (stats 3/5). On Play: draw 2 cards, then reduce the cost of the 2 most expensive cards in hand by 1 each.
PEACE BEYOND FEAR REWORKED — Cost reduced from 9 to 7 (stats 8/12). On Play: restore 5 defense, draw a card, and Exhaust all enemy followers next turn.
HOPE UNENDING BUFFED — Cost reduced from 9 to 7. Stats 5/8.
THE SPONSOR BUFFED — Arrival now summons 2 Sponsees (up from 1). All Sponsees are 3/3 base. Sponsor copy limit raised to 2.
SPONSOR TRIAL CINEMATIC — Battling The Sponsor plays a dedicated cinematic intro before the battle loads.
SPONSOR TRIAL REWARD — Defeating The Sponsor for the first time awards a ✨ Shiny Platinum copy.
upcoming_events: More seasonal content and cards are in development — check back after future updates for details.
